method: Balances are net transfers in minus out per wallet, from the explorer token lists (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum) or full-range Transfer/TransferSingle/TransferBatch logs (Optimism, Zora). Base: balanceOf on every Base artist contract for each wallet (ERC-1155 ids 0-20), all zero. A token is kept when its contract is in contracts.json, or its id carries an artist address in the top 160 bits (shared contracts). acquisition is read from the transaction that first brought the token to the wallet: value sent, ERC-20s paid by the wallet, Seaport OrderFulfilled, and transfers to artist addresses. When the token came from another collector wallet, the chain is followed back to the original acquisition and the moves are listed in laterMovedBetweenCollectorWallets.

niftyInk.method: Every NiftyToken held by the three wallets was mapped to its ink CID with tokenInk(uint256); each CID not in data/gallery.json was resolved with NiftyInk.inkInfoByInkUrl to find its artist. None of those inks are by an nnxyz address, so every nnxyz ink the collector holds is already in the archive.

notes: nnxyz inks created 2024-12-04/05: #64 (QmaMmKJ355...) and #66 (QmcnP1RHho...) were minted to nnxyz.thingelstad.eth on 2025-04-06 (txs 0x42498f..., 0x539bb1...) and are in the gallery. #65 (QmYFHCJjTX...) was bought on 2025-01-11 by 0x78e87757861185ec5e8c0ef6bf0c69fa7832df6c, not a collector wallet; the collector does not own it.
Base: no collector wallet holds a token from the five Base artist contracts.

Re-issued contracts: three Polygon contracts are later copies of earlier ones, airdropped to holders with the same token ids and names. chic city cat club 0x38651932 (deployed 2023-12-05, airdropped to the collector 2024-04-01) re-issues 0xbfdf6e51; cringe-eez doodles 0x32ad953d (2024-06-18) re-issues 0x60644a9e; Friends Of Country Air 0x84420bd6 (2023-12-05) re-issues 0x1372ce2c. The collector holds both copies of 11 cats, 2 doodles and 7 FOCA, so 110 tokens are 90 distinct works. The artist's post 1803265807914328084 (2024-06-19) announces the doodles re-issue ("you now finally have your doodles back").
